'''Gudnem's Gadget Emporium''' was a shop on the first level of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Promenade]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Near the end of the Cold War, the shop served as a front for a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[SIS safe house|safe house]], where Agent [[Rieekan (SIS)|Rieekan]] directed the SIS's operations in the area.<ref name="The Search for Agent Galen" />

However, the shop was attacked by Mark II [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guards]] under the control of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sadic]], and the Power Guards [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the store's employees and patrons on their way to the concealed turbolift that led to the SIS base. An [[Hero of Tython|unknown Jedi Knight]], who was attempting to destroy the Power Guard Project and rescue the SIS Agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]], returned to the shop and destroyed the Power Guards who were still patrolling the shop, and freed the remaining agents in the safe house below.<ref name="Striking Back" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gudnem's Gadget Emporium was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. A class story area for the Jedi Knight, the shop appears in the missions "The Search for Agent Galen" and "Striking Back" as an antechamber to the SIS safe house that can be accessed by a turbolift in the rear of the store.<ref name="The Search for Agent Galen" /><ref name="Striking Back" /> It also appears as a Bounty Hunter phase as part of [[Mako (slicer)|Mako's]] companion storyline.
